title: Amendment Notice
issuer: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Home Affairs, Armed Police Force, Nepal, Nepal A.P.F Hospital, Procurement Section, Balambu, Kathmandu, Nepal
key_points: The notice amends points related to the Supply, Delivery & Installation of Anesthesia Relevant Equipments (Contract ID. No.APFH/NCB/G/06/2083/084/003).
The deadline for payment of the non-refundable fee has been changed from 03 Mansir 2083 to 11 Mansir 2083.
The deadline for submitting sealed bids has been changed from 04 Mansir 2083 to 14 Mansir 2083.
The bid validity period requirement has been amended to be valid for 30 days beyond the bid validity period.
The specification for ABG Machine has been amended to include measurement of Blood sugar.
